final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT media_type_name, average_bytes_per_millisecond, average_bytes_per_millisecond - (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) FROM media_averages) AS amount_above_overall_average FROM media_averages WHERE average_bytes_per_millisecond > (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) FROM media_averages) ORDER BY media_type_name
